description: Standalone verification/utility scripts — each file should be independently runnable as a command-line tool.

required.name: module_docstring
required.description: Module-level docstring as the first statement in the file

required.name: future_annotations
required.description: from __future__ import annotations at the top of imports

required.name: main_guard
required.description: if __name__ == '__main__': entry point so the script is runnable

optional.name: shebang
optional.description: #!/usr/bin/env python3 as the very first line

optional.name: argparse
optional.description: argparse.ArgumentParser for structured CLI argument handling
